description: You are a marketing analyst at a digital music store using the Chinook database in LibreOffice Base. Build a customer segmentation system. Your task: (1) Create a saved SQL query named 'CustomerLifetimeValue' that joins the Customer and Invoice tables, groups by customer, and computes: CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Country, OrderCount (number of invoices), TotalSpent (SUM of Invoice totals), and AvgOrderValue (average invoice amount); (2) Create a table named 'CustomerTier' with at least columns: TierId (integer, primary key), TierName (text), MinSpend (numeric), MaxSpend (numeric), Description (text); (3) Insert at least 4 rows into CustomerTier representing distinct customer value segments — use realistic spend thresholds based on Chinook data where customer totals range from about $4 to $50 (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum tiers); (4) Create a saved SQL query named 'CustomerTierAssignment' that assigns each customer to a tier based on their total spending — must reference customer spending data and tier boundaries; (5) Create a report named 'Customer Analysis' (name must contain 'Customer') that presents the customer segmentation. All objects must be saved in chinook.odb.
